title_suffix: finer certified endpoints (1e-200) and deeper outer witness on PR1424 (80 bootstrap steps, eta=beta=1e-205, kappa grid 1e-195); construction unchanged
summary: PR1424's construction is unchanged. The certified complex endpoints (native and conservative) are refined from the inherited 1e-24 bracket to 1e-200: the retained engines still certify the 1e-24 bracket, and finer-constant copies of both rational engines certify accept at the endpoint and reject at endpoint+1e-200. The outer witness settings are deepened (bootstrap steps 80, eta = beta = 1e-205, backoff 1e-208, final kappa grid 1e-195) and the decimal fields are exact. kappa moves from 0.001676855229071321886206381217337893 to 0.001676855229071321886206456772274592619512448739510475262803365191051156655212009649515784691641384542992927543810394218063101696528820285122293539187175718645091286128304946879363305825544468149.
